note: Closed vocabulary of body skills (T4). Arg types: int, number, string, ref (opaque id string from the digest: player name, place id, entity id), item (item name), enum, bool. Names that also exist in brain/contract.js SKILLS use the same arg names.

wander.desc: one short walk toward a standable, reachable, little-visited spot

explore.desc: one long walk toward somewhere not visited before

go_to.desc: walk to a known place (home, bed, chest_1, ...)

follow.desc: follow a player for a while

approach.desc: walk up to a player or entity

return_home.desc: go back home (falls back to the breadcrumb trail)

return_to_surface.desc: retrace the breadcrumb trail until under open sky

gather_stone.desc: mine stone (crafts a wooden pickaxe from wood if needed)

hunt.desc: kill and collect food from an animal

collect_seeds.desc: break tall grass or ferns until seeds drop (about 1 in 8), for a farm; daylight, grassland

forage_plants.desc: pick ripe sweet berries / crops / melon nearby (or break oak leaves for apples) to get plant food

fish.desc: fish with a rod: walk to a bank within 16 m, cast, wait for the bite (60 s per catch), reel in, pick up the catch

craft.desc: craft an item from a small recipe set (intermediates made on demand)

cook.desc: smelt raw meat in a furnace (places or crafts one from 8 cobblestone, fuel from coal/planks/logs) and collect it

defend.desc: hit back at a player who is hitting me right now (best weapon, stops when they stop, never chases)

fight.desc: melee a hostile mob with the best weapon held (sword first)

sleep.desc: sleep in a bed (night or thunder only)

place_torch.desc: place a torch here (only if the light is low)

shelter.desc: build a sealed pillbox, wait out the night inside, reclaim the blocks

close_doors_nearby.desc: close open doors, gates and trapdoors around me

press_button.desc: press a button or set a lever at x,y,z

chest.desc: list, take from or put into the chest at x,y,z

build.desc: build a small structure from any solid blocks held (wall_ring, pillar_up, simple_hut)

dig_in.desc: emergency: seal the cell I stand in within ~10 s (walls from blocks, or dig two down and cap), no walking

hole_and_cap.desc: dig two blocks down through plain ground and cap the hole above me (no blocks needed); leave later with exit_hole

exit_hole.desc: leave a hole made by hole_and_cap: break the cap and pillar up with the blocks I hold (fills the hole)

roof_over_me.desc: build a 3x3 roof 3 blocks above my feet from any 12 solid blocks (arrows from above, phantoms, rain)

torch_perimeter.desc: place torches on a ring (about 6 m apart) around where I stand or a known place

stair_down.desc: dig a safe staircase down to target_y; stops at lava, water, air gaps and falling blocks, never digs straight down

farm_plot.desc: till a 3x3 plot near water with a hoe, plant seeds (collects them from tall grass), and remember it as place farm

farm_harvest.desc: harvest the ripe crops of my farm place and replant

breed_animals.desc: feed two adult animals of one kind in my pen (or near me) with their food (wheat: cows/sheep, carrots/potatoes: pigs, seeds: chickens) so a baby is born

pen_slaughter.desc: kill ONE adult animal of my pen for meat, only when the pen holds 3 or more animals (the rest keep breeding)

animal_pen.desc: fence a 5x5 pen around me (fences or any blocks), lure animals in with wheat/seeds if I hold some, close the gate cell

dig_stairs_up.desc: stuck in a hole or pit with no blocks to pillar: tunnel a stairwell upward through the softest blocks (hand-digs slowly if I have no pickaxe, crafts a wooden one first if I hold logs or planks)

take_cover.desc: break line of sight to skeletons (or charge a lone one when healthy and armed)

store_in_chest.desc: deposit surplus in a chest (places one if held)

look_at.desc: look at a player/entity/position, default nearest player

gesture.desc: nod, shake head, wave, jump, crouch

grass_seeds.desc: break short grass, tall grass and ferns in daylight until I hold the wanted wheat seeds (about 1 in 8 breaks drops one; the result counts seeds and breaks)

bonemeal_grass.desc: use bone meal on a grass block in an open meadow so grass sprouts around it (then break the grass for seeds); reports how many new plants it really made

bonemeal_ripen.desc: use bone meal on the unripe crops of my farm place until they are ripe (reports the ripe count before and after)

make_charcoal.desc: smelt logs into charcoal in a furnace (placed, or made from 8 cobblestone); the logs are also the fuel, so 4 charcoal need about 7 logs

collect_eggs.desc: pick up eggs lying on the ground near me (hens lay one every 5-10 min)

throw_eggs.desc: throw eggs at the chickens of my pen (or near me) so some hatch into chicks (about 1 egg in 8)

take_hay.desc: break hay bales of a village (leaves at least keep bales standing) and turn them into wheat (1 bale = 9 wheat)

harvest_ripe.desc: harvest only the RIPE crops (wheat, carrots, potatoes, beetroot) around me and replant them; unripe ones are left to grow
